corrections.originalCritique: Strongest feature: The analogy between explanatory inquiry and practical deliberation supplies an affirmative route to normative ontology, treating deliberation as a respectable project whose indispensable commitments deserve recognition rather than merely deriving realism from ordinary linguistic appearances. Principal limitation: The compressed comparison with electrons leaves the operative kind of indispensability underexplained, and it does not establish why indispensability within a practical project is sufficient for ontological commitment rather than usefulness inside that project. Live burden: The argument must defend the parity between explanatory and deliberative indispensability while showing that normative facts do indispensable work that rival attitude-centered or deflationary accounts cannot reproduce. Locked score: The strong and competent band reflects high central relevance and a clear constructive mechanism, moderated by an analogy whose sufficiency claim remains somewhat stronger than its presented warrant.

corrections.originalCritique: Strongest feature: The reply concedes rather than suppresses the reflective anomaly and introduces a useful comparative principle: explanatory awkwardness concerning exceptional cases may be less damaging than failure to capture central features of ordinary normative deliberation. Principal limitation: Centrality is asserted more than operationalized, and the response underdevelops the possibility that a rare foundational anomaly can expose a structural defect whose importance greatly exceeds its prevalence. Live burden: The proposed weighting method must distinguish explanatory centrality from mere familiarity and show why the rival-framework cases remain peripheral to the phenomenon realism claims to explain. Locked score: The very strong band recognizes high relevance, strong responsiveness, explicit concession, and proportionate calibration, while the remaining evidential and charitable limitations concern the justification of the comparative weights rather than the coherence of weighting costs.
